Seasonal adjustment is a key process in official statistics, as it is necessary for the dissemination and interpretation of a large number of economic indicators. In order to harmonise practices, Eurostat has officially recommended the use of [JDemetra+](www.jdemetra.org) since 2015. This open-source software provides access to the two most popular seasonal adjustment algorithms used by European statistical agencies: X-13 ARIMA and TRAMO-SEATS, via a graphical user interface and a family of R packages. These pages describes how to use version 3 of JDemetra+ to create efficient production processes that can adjust several thousand series with customised settings, while ensuring statistical quality and minimising manual fine-tuning.
